`listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `DataStore.java` now sorts open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. It uses the same `ORDER BY CASE t.priority …` as the sales-rep query. I also updated the method's Javadoc to match.

The tests I ran (`-Dtest='*Ticket*'`) passed, but nothing in `src` calls `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` except `RegionManagerService`, so no test exercises the new order. I didn't add a test, and I haven't run your T-1 to T-5 example.

Closed tickets and other regions' tickets are still excluded, since the filters are unchanged. Nothing is committed.
